compilation.text: Shows same graph as before with post January results: Conservatives drop sharply from about 43-44% to roughly 37-38% (down ~6 points), Liberals surge from around 20-21% to about 42-43% (up ~21-22 points), NDP fall from roughly 18-19% to near 8-9% (down ~10 points), Bloc Québécois ease slightly from about 8-9% to 6-7%, and Greens decline from around 4% to about 2-3%; overall, the new data shows a rapid realignment driven primarily by a large shift from NDP and Conservative support toward the Liberals.
